lines: Early afternoon on a day offー
Kamimura Maika was in nearby Maesaki City, having left Gosha Village and arriving earlier.
Kamimura Maika
(Woohoo~!! I got tons of super cute items!! It's been quite a while since I went on such a shoppin' spree!!)
There were many shopping bags placed around Maika.
Her favorite shop had been having a sale, so she had gotten carried away and ended up buying stuff like crazy.
Maika
(Cuttin' loose every once in a while is alright, I guess! I mean, I couldn't even wear somethin' like this in Gosha...)
By "something like this," Maika meant the outfit she was wearing right now.
In the complete opposite of her usual tough-looking, boyish attire, Maika was dressed in total "gyaru"-style flamboyant fashion.
Maika
(If I wore somethin' like this over there, those guys at the academy would be in an uproar.)
Maika
(Damn it, what difference does it make whatever clothes I wear!!)
Looking slightly disgruntled, Maika pouted her lips.
In fact, Maika loved stuff like cute and girly trinkets, as well as gyaru fashion.
But since she was putting on a tough and cool act at the academy, she couldn't openly enjoy them.
And that's why Maika, on her days off, would head out to the nearby city, which the others from the academy didn't visit very often...
...and would partake in her secret hobby of heartily enjoying her beloved fashion like this.
Maika
(Well... it's one of my precious days off, so I'll stop my grumblin' about boring crap!)
Maika
(I already had as much fun as I could today... so I guess I'll pull outta here before I run into any rabble from the academy.)
And just as Maika was thinking such thoughts while taking a break at the convenience store in front of the stationー
Suspicious Man
Oh my, what's a cute girl like you doing here? Are you free right now?
Maika
Huuh!? What's it to ya!?
The man was the spitting image of a shady talent scout.
He was completely unfazed by Maika's intimidating gaze.
Suspicious Man
Ohhh~ no, no♪ You're super cute, so if you make a scary face like that, it's all going to be for nothing.
Maika
Y-You're callin' me cute...!?
Suspicious Man
Yes. Your fashion sense is spot on, and I bet you're very popular at school, right?
Maika
N-Not really... I mean, a bit, I guess...?
Maika was unusually tongue-tied.
She seemed unable to hide her excitement at being complimented in that way, something she didn't experience much.
Maika
A-And... what do ya want with me...!?
Suspicious Man
Ehehe♪ You're going to be so excited when you hear. Come on, let's talk over thereー
Three days laterー
Igawa Asagi
Frankly speaking, I have something to ask of you all, the Independent Commando Unit.
After school, Headmistress Asagi had called me to her office and began right away without even a word of greeting.
Me
So it's a mission. And what will it be this time...?
I cautiously asked Headmistress Asagi.
The expression on her face was darkened with something like anxiety.
Hmmm...
I had a strong hunch that the mission this time was going to be just as much trouble as the ones before...
Asagi
Right. You know Kamimura Maika-san, don't you?
Me
Well yeah, because we're in the same class.
Kamimura Maika was a classmate of mine.
I had shied away from her overtly delinquent behavior...
...but since we had been on the same team during the practical exam, we were now able to talk to each other in a reasonably friendly manner.
Contrary to her tough-looking appearance and behavior, she was surprisingly nice once you got to talking with her.
Me
What about her?
When I asked, Headmistress Asagi seemed worried and let out a small sighー
Asagi
Apparently, she's gone missing.
Asagi
She hasn't been home for the last few days and her friends also can't reach herー
Me
What...?
That evening, in the entertainment district of the nearby Maesaki Cityー
Aishu Hebiko
Hmmm. So she said to look for Maika-chan, huh.
On our way here, I had briefly explained the situation to Hebiko and Shikanosuke.
Incidentally, this entertainment district in Maesaki City was the last spot where Maika had been seen.
Me
To be honest, I think this is a bit of an overreaction.
Me
Even if she's been gone, she's a delinquent, isn't she? Isn't she just enjoying the nightlife or something?
Uehara Shikanosuke
H-How can you say that, Fuma!! Kamimura-san isn't such an irresponsible person!!
For some reason Shikanosuke lashed out at me mightily.
Me
Huh? You're being awfully protective, aren't you.
Shikanosuke
I-I'm not being protective!! It's just because you said something so insulting about Kamimura-san...
Me
Hmmm...
Shikanosuke
Wh-What is it...?
Me
Come to think of it, last time you also talked quite passionately about Maika.
He had gotten pretty worked up, going on about how, "She's the one I admire" and "I want to be like that."
Me
Sure enough, you're in love with her, aren't you?
Seeing Shikanosuke turn bright red was funny, so I pushed the matter further.
Shikanosuke
Th-That's not true!! I just want to say that Kamimura-san is a very nice personー
Me
A nice person, huh?
Shikanosuke
Y-Yes, that's right! Just the other day, I saw her holding an umbrella over a stray cat that was getting wet in the rain...
Me
Are we in an old shojo manga or something?
Hebiko
Ah, Hebiko also saw something like that. Maika-chan took a granny by the hand and crossed the street with her.
Me
Just how much is this girl getting her choice moments witnessed...?
Don't tell me, maybe she was secretly piling up good deeds left and right?
Me
I mean, even I won't deny that Maika is a good person.
Shikanosuke
You'd better not!?
Me
It's just... her strength is top-class amongst our generation.
It was said that her aptitude as a Taimanin was on the same level as Mizuki Yukikaze, famed for her Lightning Jutsu.
Me
Someone like her wouldn't just get nabbed by some hoodlums around here.
So I had guessed that she might have just been hitting the night clubs.
Shikanosuke
Uhh... th-that's true...
Hebiko
That makes Hebiko worry even more. What could've happened to Maika-chan...?
While the three of us were talking, we arrived at the downtown area where Maika had last been seen.
Me
Well, let's gather some information for now. Let's split up and then meet up again after a while.
Two hours laterー
After splitting up and asking around, we had met up again in a narrow backstreet.
Me
I see... Now it's getting a bit easier to see the situation...
If you added up the information the three of us had gathered, it looked like this:
Three days ago in the evening, Maika and a suspicious man had been seen walking through the downtown area.
And interestingly, it seemed that Maika wasn't the only one who had gone missing.
We had been told that in this neighborhood several people had disappeared recently.
And the common feature the missing people shared was that all of them excelled in combat.
Beyond that, there were also rumors that people who had disappeared would return with completely different personalities, and so on and so forth...
Hebiko
So Maika-chan isn't the only one who disappeared.
Me
Yeah. This incident might be more of a pain in the ass than I thought.
The part about them "returning with completely different personalities" was especially concerning.
If that was true, then it would mean that a real good-for-nothing was involved in this...
Shikanosuke
H-Hey!! Is this gonna be okay, Fuma!? I'm getting bad vibes like crazy!!
Always quick to get worked up, Shikanosuke was already starting to freak out.
And at that momentー
Fürst
My, my, so it was you three stealthily snooping around about meー
Me
ーYou!??
It had happened without a moment's notice.
A tall man was standing in front of us like he had seeped out of the darkness of the backstreet.
Shikanosuke
Aieeeeee!? Something's here!?
Hebiko
Th-This guy isー!!!
Me
ーFürst, the demonologist.
One of the senior executives of Nomad who had infiltrated the academy as "Muroi-sensei" a while back.
He was considered to be the one who had enticed Gaiza and was a target that demanded extreme caution.
Fürst
Oh-ho-ho... Long time no see, my pupils. I'm glad that you seem well.
Me
Shut up. I'm getting sick just listening to you.
He was as unpleasant a man as ever.
Me

More importantly, what you said just beforeー
Are the rampant disappearances in this area your doing?
Fürst
My doing? Hmm, who knows?
Fürst evaded my interrogation with an innocent look on his face.
Me
I see. Then we'll just have to detain you! There's a lot I want to ask you regarding Gaiza as well.
I sent Hebiko and Shikanosuke a signal with my eyes.
I didn't know what his intentions were, but him coming out on his own was a good opportunity.
Fürst
Oh my? You're some scary children, hmm.
But Fürst showed no sign of being distressed at allー
Fürst
Oh-ho-ho. This is perfect timing, though. In fact, I was just looking for someone to test "this" on.
He laughed elegantly and called out to the darkness behind him.
Fürst
Come on outー"Maika." Those three over there will be your enemiesーTake care of them, and don't hold back.
Me
M-Maika...!?
Those words were beyond surprising to us.
Taken aback, we froze completely, and in front of usー
Maika
Yeah, got it, "Master." I just have to kill these brats, right...?
Emerging with a displeased look on her face, the woman wearing a Taima-SuitーKamimura Maikaーaimed her weapon at us.
